title: I asked Claude Fable 5.2 to make a 2.5D pixel-art game and its trailer. 6 hours later: 8 chapters, a gunfight, a kaiju, and this.
author: Upset_Cellist6256
selftext:
*“Make a 2.5D pixel-art game with lots of detail, and cut a trailer for it.”*

The video above is the trailer. Claude rendered it as well: it drove the game in headless Chrome, captured the frames, and encoded them with ffmpeg.

**What came out**

* **SKYWAVE**, a cinematic platformer set in a foggy port city. You play a pirate radio crew trying to stay on air through one night.
* 8 chapters, including a gunfight on the docks and a boss fight against a sea monster called the Undertow.
* **There are no image or audio files in the repo.** Every sprite, building, character and sound effect is generated in code.
* A real 3D world sits behind the pixel-art play plane, with a ground that runs to the horizon and buildings that have sides and roofs. WebGL2 adds lighting, bloom, depth of field, rain and wet-floor reflections on top.
* A varied cast: heavy guys, old men, women, kids, a swimsuit character.
* TypeScript and Vite, with 118 tests passing.

Repo : [https://github.com/rokrokss/thelastnight](https://github.com/rokrokss/thelastnight)
